newsitem.title: USA: Comstock buys stakes in 13 wells.
newsitem.headline: Comstock buys stakes in 13 wells.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said Tuesday it entered into a purchase and sale agreement with 28 parties to acquire working interests in the Lisbon Field in Claiborne Parish, La.
Comstock will acquire interests, for $20.7 million, in 13 wells (7.1 net) producing from multiple Cotton Valley sands at depths from 8,560 to 8,999 feet.

Included also in the sale are about 6,400 gross undeveloped acres in the Lisbon Field. The acquisition includes all production after January 31 and is expected to close by the end of April 1997, the company said.
Comstock intends to fund the acquisition with borrowings under its $166 million bank revolving credit facility.
"We expect that the acquisition will have a positive impact on the company's earnings and cash flow beginning in May 1997," said M. Jay Allison, president and chief executive officer of Comstock.
